name: the-ai-maker
description: Engineer the most effective domain-specific AI system for any project, with evidence and real-world evaluation.

interface.shortDescription: Design, compare and evaluate AI systems with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Problem discovery, research across papers, models and ~950 production case studies, ≥3 architectures scored with a robustness-tested decision engine, live model prices, sample-size planning, an evaluation harness with significance tests and judge calibration, a defensive LLM red-team set, and an implementation blueprint.
defaultPrompt: What is the best AI approach for this project? Give me the full blueprint.
Compare the cost of these models for our workload.
Build an evaluation plan and red-team set for our LLM feature.
